instruction: Use Edge Immersive Reader to complete the sunscreen entry in `health-sunscreen_reference.xlsx` on the Desktop using only the AP News article. Fill in the missing information, save the spreadsheet, and leave Immersive Reader open.
gt_steps: With the AP News sunscreen article active in Microsoft Edge, press `F9` to enter Immersive Reader.
Open `health-sunscreen_reference.xlsx` from the Desktop in LibreOffice Calc.
Enter `6 months and older` in the Minimum age field.
Enter `Parsol Shield` in the Initial U.S. brand field.
Enter `both ultraviolet A and B rays` in the UV protection field.
Leave Immersive Reader open on the AP News article.

result.command: C:\Users\Docker\AppData\Local\Programs\Python\Python310\python.exe -c "from openpyxl import load_workbook; from pathlib import Path; p=Path.home()/'Desktop'/'health-sunscreen_reference.xlsx'; ws=load_workbook(p, data_only=True).active; print('Ingredient: '+str(ws['B2'].value)); print('Minimum age: '+str(ws['C2'].value)); print('Initial U.S. brand: '+str(ws['D2'].value)); print('UV protection: '+str(ws['E2'].value))"

points: Minimum age: six months and older
Minimum age: six months or older
UV protection: both ultraviolet A and B rays
UV protection: ultraviolet A and ultraviolet B
